about: The web-game-template revision this Factory is validated against: the latest RELEASE of the template, by tag and by the commit the tag points at. init creates every game from exactly this tree (a repository GitHub generates from another revision is brought to it by one local commit), the tech plan records it as repo_params.template_ref, and every test that reads template files uses a checkout of it (scripts/wgflib/template.py). Change it only in a commit where the Factory's acceptance runs pass on the new revision (WGF_TEMPLATE_COMMIT=<sha> bin/wgf test-core, then a real new-game run).
platform_adapters_about: The platform ids the pinned commit has an SDK adapter for: the KNOWN_PLATFORM_IDS of packages/platform-sdk/src/registry.ts at that commit (check-integrity.py and test_core_template hold the two equal). Strategy and tech-plan refuse to target any other platform, because createPlatform() throws at boot for it. Moving the pin moves this list in the same commit.

golden_ports.about: Test fixtures only, never a revision a game is created from: the golden runs' replay developer (scripts/golden/replay_developer.py) reads its hand-made ports (examples/*/wgf-golden/, examples/wgf-golden-shared/) from a checkout of this commit, because the pinned release above does not ship them. It is the play-probe ports (1c5afcb: the template's main at the merge of the ports onto the release, plus their play probe and on-screen objective) with both reference ports' production art merged in - Tower Merge Rush (8f49d28) and Neon Drift Arena (7c132ef): each port's library/ (the art library the golden run's assets step imports; Blender-built GLBs for the 3D one) and baseline/ (the approved frames its baseline visual QA compares against) - plus the 2D port's greybox ground deepened so a build without its backdrop is not a wash and its asset loader moved out of src/assets/ (code, not an asset), and the 3D port's greybox (plain boxes when no runtime manifest exists) and its baseline's states.json - then (branch wgf-golden-content) the content the production gate's font.coverage and variants checks require: the 2D library's towers 9 and 10 (the drop-merge rules reach level 10) and Latin + Cyrillic faces for both ports (2D Rubik Mono One + Manrope, 3D Commissioner for Instrument Sans), both ports' baselines re-captured. Outside the ports - and one tsconfig exclude for them - its tree is the release's. On top of it (dyCuong03/agent-game-audio, merged with wgf-golden-content db7b140): both ports' music and sound effects as library assets (library/audio/, composed as code in library/tools/audio-score.js and rendered by examples/wgf-golden-shared/library/tools/audio/render.mjs, with CC0 Kenney layers), the shared audio service that plays them (examples/wgf-golden-shared/src/audio/audio.ts), the play probes' `audio` field and the ports' @audio browser tests. Its 3D baseline is re-captured with the sound toggle every screen now shows. Then (dyCuong03/agent-golden-reconcile) the template's main merged in - the Phaser engine (v1.2.0's successor) and contract 2 - with the ports restructured onto it: each supplies src/game/index.ts (createGame(context)) and no main.ts, its loading, fonts, audio, play probe and screens re-expressed there, the play probe and sound load deferred to #hud[data-ready]; the 3D mapping no longer copies the example's procedural arena-view.ts. Because the release above is still contract 1, examples/wgf-golden-shared/release-1/ carries a temporary boot bridge (the release's boot order with the Factory seam, calling createGame) that the replay writes only into a repository without src/game/context.ts. Then (fix/golden-hud-contrast) an opaque plate behind every Neon Drift Arena HUD text, because production-quality now reads the worst region behind a text and the cyan SCORE over the sun measured ~2.3:1; baseline frames not re-captured.
